content.comment_body: I'm having trouble connecting to several [product_name] devices. I've tried two different models: one with DC 12/24V (8 input/4 output), and another with AC/DC 24V (8 input/4 output). I can only establish communication with the AC/DC variant. Could the issue be related to my software ([product_name] [product_name] [version_no]) or perhaps the cable I'm using to connect?
Hello, Networking isn't supported. How do you intend to connect and communicate between the [product_name] devices?

Hi [user_name], I believe [user_name] means they can only connect their software to one of the devices. Is that correct? If so, one of the devices might be a newer model with [article_no]. Typically, a message like 'You need a newer version of this program' appears when trying to connect. Please update your software to the latest version [version_no] via 'help -> update center.' If this doesn't resolve your issue, feel free to reach out again.

Yes, that's correct, only one device is accessible. I'll try updating my software and let you know if it works. I've also attached a file showing the message that appears, but it doesn't match the one you described.
I've attempted the update, but it hasn't resolved the problem. The update process completes successfully, yet the 'about' section still shows [version_no].

Did you use the Update function (not to be confused with Upgrade)? Alternatively, you could download the necessary file from [url], save it, and then load it via the Update Center in [product_name] [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering compatibility and connection challenges between different versions of [product_name] hardware and corresponding software. Even after attempting software updates, the issue remains since one device is still not supported and the software version does not reflect the intended update. Terminology differences between 'update' and 'upgrade' also contribute to confusion among users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect seamless communication between both [product_name] device models and anticipate that software updates will resolve compatibility issues highlighted by error messages.
